title: Special Executive Programme In Managing Employment Relations And Employment Law
description: The course aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of employment relations and employment law to help manage workplace issues effectively.
longDescription: This course delves into the core aspects of employment law and employment relations, exploring key legal frameworks, employee rights, HR policies, and the dismissal process. It equips learners with the tools to navigate complex legal structures and manage employment relations ethically and legally.
courseDetails: The concept of employment dismissal. The various types of dismissal. Various reasons for fair and unfair dismissal. Various signs of constructive dismissal. Various examples of wrongful dismissal. Steps for dismissing an employee. Employment Legislation. Key Issues Covered in the Employment Legislation. What is Employment Contract? Types of Employment Contracts. Contractual Terms. Express Terms. Key Terms of Employment Contract. Key types of Employee Rights. The sources of United Kingdom Employment Law. Types of recognised workers. United Kingdom employment courts. Salary and benefits. Holidays, Sick Pay. Maternity and Paternity Leave. Employment Discrimination. In this program, learners will gain a solid understanding of employment law fundamentals, including contract terms, dismissal procedures, and regulatory requirements affecting HR policies. Topics include UK employment law origins, employment protection, and employee rights. The course also covers how legal considerations influence HR strategies, with a focus on compliance, fairness, and ethical management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Key concepts in employment law in a country: Employment Protection and Dismissal: Employment Contract Terms: Employment Law and Organisational Legal Structure: Employee Rights in Labour Law:
